** Systems
*** nix-darwin
The username is detected from the environment (=SUDO_USER= / =USER=) via impure evaluation, so the same =.#darwin= configuration works on any macOS machine regardless of the login user (pure evaluation falls back to =kyre=).

First time on a new machine:
#+begin_src shell
  sudo nix run nix-darwin/master#darwin-rebuild -- switch --flake .#darwin --impure
#+end_src

After that (the wrapper passes =--impure= automatically):
#+begin_src shell
  sudo nix run . -- --show-trace
#+end_src

*** NixOS-WSL
#+begin_src shell
  sudo nixos-rebuild switch --flake .#wsl --show-trace
#+end_src

*** ThinkPad X230
#+begin_src shell
 sudo nixos-rebuild switch --flake .#x230 --show-trace
#+end_src

** bun2nix
in inputs/bun2nix/
#+begin_src shell
 bun install
 nix run github:nix-community/bun2nix -- -o bun.nix
#+end_src

** Format
#+begin_src shell
 nix fmt ./
#+end_src

** Agent Skills

External Skills are pinned in =inputs/skills/=. Jev-cu is distributed only to
Codex, with its runtime examples pointing to the pinned, read-only upstream
source. CUA observes and acts one step at a time; a separate host CLI,
=self/scripts/jev-cu-bws.mjs --bws=, reads =TYPESAFE_API_KEY= from the
=self-automation= BWS project in a child process. CUA must reobserve and check
the original complete target label before acting. The bridge cannot be
imported into CUA because its process APIs are unavailable there. Keep
credentials out of Nix and skill files. Optional host-side traces use
=$XDG_STATE_HOME/jev-cu/runs=, falling back to =~/.local/state/jev-cu/runs=.

** DSH

DSH is managed by the independent [[https://github.com/Kyure-A/dsh-config][dsh-config]] flake. That repository owns
the pinned backend and plugins, common defaults, native Mac application,
launchers, settings synchronization, and Home Manager/NixOS modules.

This repository only consumes its Home Manager module in
=modules/home/programs/dsh/default.nix=. The host declares DSH enabled, the
local node name, the SSH synchronization peer, and the initial instructions
file. The Tailscale hostname is derived from =dsh-config.lib.network.fqdn=;
its domain is defined once in =dsh-config/config/network.nix=.

Update the input after publishing a dsh-config change:

#+begin_src shell
 nix flake update dsh-config
#+end_src

For a local source build without changing the committed input pin:

#+begin_src shell
 nix build .#darwinConfigurations.darwin.config.home-manager.users.kyre.home.activationPackage --override-input dsh-config path:/absolute/path/to/dsh-config --no-write-lock-file
#+end_src

Open =DSH.app= from Home Manager Apps, use =dsh-web= for browser access, or
=dsh --profile headless "task"= for a terminal task. Writable configuration,
conversations and native OAuth credentials stay in =~/.dsh=. The existing
Venice credential in =~/.pi/agent/auth.json= and Strata credential in
=~/.config/dsh/strata-rvn.key= retain their current storage paths.

Mac and Avalon exchange supported UI settings over SSH; credentials and
conversation history do not synchronize. The initial =AGENTS.md= is copied
only when absent and stays writable thereafter. See dsh-config's README for
account setup, service operation and rollback instructions.
